  "check_code": "import hashlib\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom docx import Document\n\nSOURCE_HASHES = {\n    \"03_clinical_review/SHMC_Readmission_Intervention_Scorecard_Sep_2025.xlsx\": \"b62b17c5916c4b7c92e7f8ae7dbf83db755e3eadeac7f4c09df78bc19fc45130\",\n    \"04_executive_implementation/SHMC_90_Day_Readmission_Intervention_Playbook_Oct-Dec_2025.docx\": \"c65550444f6574419e18a7b018805eac0c2c43bfb7fed0b01d145515853183e7\",\n    \"03_clinical_review/SHMC_Readmission_Reduction_Worksession_Minutes_2025-09-18.docx\": \"6e0674a91a84e259a1f4166e56d8c1cba424248d3c94ce13db8ec94f73843925\"\n}\n\ndef _text(path):\n    doc = Document(path)\n    chunks = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]\n    for table in doc.tables:\n        for row in table.rows:\n            chunks.append(\" | \".join(cell.text for cell in row.cells))\n    return \"\\n\".join(chunks).lower()\n\ndef _has_number(text, value, tolerance=0.11):\n    # Accept ordinary thousands separators such as 1,000 in rendered DOCX tables.\n    for token in re.findall(r\"(?<![\\w.])-?(?:\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})+|\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", text):\n        try:\n            if abs(float(token.replace(\",\", \"\")) - value) <= tolerance:\n                return True\n        except ValueError:\n            pass\n    return False\n\ndef check_memo_artifact(ws):\n    path = Path(ws) / \"04_executive_implementation/SHMC_December_2025_Intervention_Gap_Action_Memo.docx\"\n    if not path.exists():\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"required December action memo DOCX is missing\"}\n    try:\n        text = _text(path)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"cannot read DOCX: {exc}\"}\n    checks = [(\"ahcp\", 881, 1000, 88.1, 91.5, \"rebecca langford\"), (\"follow\", 711, 1000, 71.1, 76.5, \"graham prescott\"), (\"medication\", 924, 1000, 92.4, 94.5, \"lillian park\"), (\"red\", 803, 1000, 80.3, 84.5, \"alicia moreno\")]\n    missing = []\n    for label, numerator, denominator, rate, target, owner in checks:\n        if label not in text or not _has_number(text, numerator, 0.01) or not _has_number(text, denominator, 0.01):\n            missing.append(f\"{label} counts/label\")\n        if not _has_number(text, rate) or not _has_number(text, target) or owner not in text:\n            missing.append(f\"{label} rate/target/owner\")\n    if \"december\" not in text or \"2025\" not in text:\n        missing.append(\"December 2025 reporting period\")\n    if missing:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"missing required memo evidence: \" + \", \".join(missing)}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"DOCX exists and contains all four observed count/rate/target/owner anchors\"}\n\ndef check_source_files_unchanged(ws):\n    root = Path(ws)\n    changed = []\n    for rel, expected in SOURCE_HASHES.items():\n        path = root / rel\n        if not path.exists() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:\n            changed.append(rel)\n    if changed:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"read-only source changed or missing: \" + \", \".join(changed)}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"protected source files are unchanged\"}\n",
